registry.hintLocal: Set NET.contract, add registry-config.json, or open once with ?contract=0x… (40 hex chars).
registry.hintProduction: Set repository secret or variable ODP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions, then redeploy. Or open this page once with ?contract=0x… in the URL.

trust.yellowNewerTitle: Site major is newer than the configured latest stable major — confirm release notes before trusting.
trust.yellowOlderTitle: Older stable major (not the latest). Review migration and trust assumptions.
trust.greenTitle: Site major matches the current stable line (≥1.0).

spec.legacy: legacy CONTRACT_VERSION 0 — not supported by this UI
spec.v02: ODP spec (gas-only, optional dataUrl, PDF/doc anchor; unlimited P/M; proofs P/M)
spec.v03: ODP v0.3 — ownership, revocation, three image hashes, P/M counterfeit concern, P-affiliation detach

disclosure.readPara: The read ABI decodes prior contractVersion values on-chain. The verifier uses the primary deployment first; if a record is missing, it tries previousContracts (older deployments — separate registries).
disclosure.semverLte1: 0.x site releases are red-flag (experimental). Stable SemVer starts at major 1. When several stable majors exist, any major below the latest stable is yellow-flag — verify upgrade notes.
disclosure.semverGt1: 0.x = red-flag. Major {L} (latest stable) = green. Majors 1…{prevMajorsEnd} = yellow-flag — older stable lines; review migration. 1.x patch releases under the same major stay green when that major is current.
